Rory McIlroy is the latest golfer to achieve back-to-back Masters victories.
Only four players in history have defended their Masters title.
Jack Nicklaus achieved back-to-back Masters victories in 1965–66.
Nick Faldo achieved back-to-back Masters victories in 1989–90.
Tiger Woods achieved back-to-back Masters victories in 2001–02.
